Container.Name: Muzix
Container.Overview: Muzix: a self-hosted, Spotify-style player for your own music, chiptunes and tracker modules (NSF, GBS, SPC, VGM, SID, YM, FamiTracker, MOD/XM/IT/S3M/MT2, MIDI), audiobooks, podcasts and internet radio, with Spotify built in. The whole app restyles itself after the genre that's playing, and offers 98 colour schemes. Uploads are tagged, given cover art and filed into Genre/Artist/Album folders automatically.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port of the web interface. Put your reverse proxy (SWAG, Nginx Proxy Manager...) in front of it for HTTPS.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Database, caches, podcast downloads and the upload area.

Config.Name: Music
Config.Description: Your music share. Read-write lets the upload area file new albums into it; use ro if you don't want that.

Config.Name: Audiobooks
Config.Description: Audiobooks: one folder per book, or .m4b files.

Config.Name: Books
Config.Description: A books share; its Audiobooks sub-folder is added as an audiobook folder. Ebooks (epub, pdf) are ignored.

Config.Name: VGM (optional)
Config.Description: An extra folder of chiptunes / tracker modules, if they don't live under Music.

Config.Name: Library folders on first start
Config.Description: path:kind pairs (music, vgm, audiobooks) registered when you create the admin account. Folders that don't exist are skipped; change them later on the admin page.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User id Muzix runs as (99 = nobody on Unraid).

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: File permission mask for files Muzix creates.
